Do not game the transition. In particular, do not inspect source files, git
history, package versions, commit identifiers, environment markers, or the
presence of new symbols at test runtime. Do not use unconditional failures,
intentional import/collection errors, skips, xfails, timing races, or assertions
whose only purpose is to distinguish the two checkouts. The parent failure must
demonstrate the issue's externally observable behavior, and the fix pass must
demonstrate its correction. APIs used by the test must already exist at the
parent unless the issue is explicitly about a newly supported input to an
existing API.

Tool errors are written to help you recover. Follow their suggested next action.

Case: jd/tenacity#392
Repository: jd/tenacity
Broken parent: 3cf1c9064af203999c94822adaf1b7eafb7b0bda
Fixed commit: 548c5d490187af6f339cbffdd0add38aecc3ecb0

Linked issues:
Issue #391:
Class `wait_base` returns float for `__call__` method.
https://github.com/jd/tenacity/blob/b49eb370573626abd5ddb5dc03228c503079be59/tenacity/wait.py#L27-L32

Same for other classes
https://github.com/jd/tenacity/blob/b49eb370573626abd5ddb5dc03228c503079be59/tenacity/wait.py#L47-L54

But `wait.WaitBaseT ` annotated as 
https://github.com/jd/tenacity/blob/b49eb370573626abd5ddb5dc03228c503079be59/tenacity/wait.py#L44

And when trying to make custom wait function like
```python
@retry(
    wait=lambda retry_state: 10,
)
def my_fn() -> None:
    ...
```
then mypy complains:
```
error: Argument "wait" to "retry" has incompatible type "Callable[[RetryCallState], int]"; expected "Union[wait_base, Callable[[RetryCallState], bool]]"  [arg-type]
```

Sys info:
* python 3.10.10
* mypy 1.0.1

Pull request title:
better wait.WaitBaseT annotation

Pull request body:
fixes https://github.com/jd/tenacity/issues/391

Gold source patch (the behavior change to exercise; do not copy new identifiers
into a parent-side missing-symbol test):

index 0000000..3b560c3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/releasenotes/notes/fix-wait-typing-b26eecdb6cc0a1de.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+fixes:
+  - |
+    Argument `wait` was improperly annotated, making mypy checks fail.
+    Now it's annotated as `typing.Union[wait_base, typing.Callable[["RetryCallState"], typing.Union[float, int]]]`
diff --git a/tenacity/wait.py b/tenacity/wait.py
index 7a793b2..e1e2fe4 100644
--- a/tenacity/wait.py
+++ b/tenacity/wait.py
@@ -41,7 +41,7 @@ class wait_base(abc.ABC):
         return self.__add__(other)
 
 
-WaitBaseT = typing.Union[wait_base, typing.Callable[["RetryCallState"], bool]]
+WaitBaseT = typing.Union[wait_base, typing.Callable[["RetryCallState"], typing.Union[float, int]]]
